column1: # bios-r2-x005.tsv -- DUMPBIOS disk round, closing table for BIOS-STOR-005:
# a boot sector with tot16 = tot32 = 0 (probe case X06,
# measurements/measurement-2026-10-28-bios-storage-audit/method/bstprobe.c;
# docs/audits/2026-10-28-bios-storage.md), against EmuTOS 1a7484ab
# (docs/analysis/ORACLE.md; TASK/TOOL07).  EmuTOS logs the disk in with
# numcl 0 and no B_16 (bios/blkdev.c:730-733, 743-752): recsiz stays 512, so
# the logical path still works and the table RESTORES the boot sector
# logically -- the only closing table that does.
# WHERE IT RUNS -- as bios-r2.tsv: the oracle's profile disk
# (HATARI_ORACLE_DISK=<test.img> tools/hatari-oracle.sh disk ...) and on NewTOS
# a card from tools/mkcard.sh with MKCARD_TESTDISK (cargo xtask tosdump bios
# --disk ...). The test image: tools/mktestdisk.sh
# NEWDESK.INF=<inf>, the one of bios-r2.tsv (sha256 d95a60c3...); C: = LBA 63,
# DESTRUCTIVE ("!disk 2 destructive", docs/TOS-REFERENCE-DUMPER.md section 6,
# "The closing tables"): the table changes C:'s boot sector and ends with it
# changed -- on EmuTOS a failed Getbpb leaves recsiz 0 (bios/blkdev.c:601),
# after which no logical Rwabs reaches the disk (blkdev.c:443-444), so there is
# no logical way back.  It runs on a fresh clone of the test image only (the
# runners refuse otherwise), and both sides must END in the same state: the
# test partitions after the run are compared (RUNINFO of the run).
#   +set <TAB> <offset>=<byte>,...  changes the buffer the read prelude right
#   before it filled; the write after it writes "read + set" back.
#   End state: the test partition as before the run (the restore writes the
#   image's tot32 0x0001FFA1 back; tot16 at 0x13 is 0 in the image).
# One table per round: a case id is the physical line number and the dump
# header carries the CRC of this file, so it is frozen once measured.
!disk

column5: Getbpb(2) before: the image's BPB -- blkdev.c:569-777

column1: # ---- the patch: tot16 (0x13) = tot32 (0x20) = 0
+set

column5: X06 write the patched boot sector, RW_NOMEDIACH -- blkdev.c:450-453, 473-477
X06a Mediach(2) after it: forcechange -- blkdev.c:799-803
X06b Getbpb(2): numcl 0, no B_16 (BIOS-STOR-005) -- blkdev.c:730-733, 743-752
X06d read sector 0: the patched fields, bytes 16-47 -- blkdev.c:430-481
X06e read sector 1: recsiz 512 stays -- blkdev.c:430-481
X06f read the last sector: the partition's size, not the BPB's -- blkdev.c:461-463

column1: # ---- the restore: tot32 back to 130977 = 0x0001FFA1, logically
+set

column5: X06g write the restored boot sector, RW_NOMEDIACH -- blkdev.c:450-453, 473-477
X06h Mediach(2) after it: forcechange -- blkdev.c:799-803
X06i Getbpb(2): the image's BPB again -- blkdev.c:569-777
X06k read sector 0: the image's bytes 16-47 again -- blkdev.c:430-481
